description: This file defines the ShareAccountTransactionEnumData class, a serializable data container representing transaction status and types for share accounts, with associated boolean flags for specific transaction states.

classes.name: ShareAccountTransactionEnumData
classes.description: A Java class that encapsulates share account transaction status data, including identifiers, codes, values, and boolean flags indicating various transaction states.

methods.name: ShareAccountTransactionEnumData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data object with an ID, code, value, and sets boolean flags based on the ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the transaction enum data.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the transaction enum data.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the transaction enum data.

methods.name: isApplied
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction is in the applied state.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction is approved.

methods.name: isRejected
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction was rejected.

methods.name: isPurchased
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction is a purchase.

methods.name: isRedeemed
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction has been redeemed.

methods.name: isChargePayment
methods.description: Returns whether the transaction is a charge payment.
